LAW AND MOTION 302, DEFENDANT HAIGHT ASHBURY FREE CLINICS, INC.'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT/AND IN THE ALTERNATIVE SUMMARY ADJUDICATION. ARGUED AND THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: MOTION GRANTED IN PART, AND DENIED IN PART. MOTION GRANTED AS TO 2ND CAUSE OF ACTION FOR RETALIATION AND 3RD CAUSE OF ACTION FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT. NO OPPOSITION FILED. MOTION DENIED AS TO 1ST, 4TH, 5TH AND 6TH CAUSES OF ACTION. TRIABLE ISSUES OF FACT EXIST CONCERNING WHETHER PLAINTIFF WAS PERFORMING HIS JOB SATISFACTORILY, AND WHETHER PLAINTIFF WAS TERMINATED FOR HIS CONDUCT OR FOR HIS COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE CLINIC'S ALLEGEDLY ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES. FACTUAL DISPUTE EXISTS REGARDING WHETHER PLAINTIFF WORKED UNDER THE DIRECTION OF SULLIVAN OR WITH DISCRETION AND INDEPENDENT JUDGMENT, AND WHETHER PLAINTIFF WAS ENGAGED IN INTELLECTUAL AND CREATIVE WORK. (ENDORSED COPY OF ORDER RE: EVIDENTIARY OBJECTIONS HANDED TO COUNSEL BEFORE THE HEARING). PREVAILING PARTY TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER.
